features.name: run.py — standalone launcher
features.detail: Boots the FastAPI app via uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8000 with reload. Standalone entry point from the pre-merge POC; in the merged world FileHQ is started by Naya, not by this script directly.

features.name: FastAPI app (50+ endpoints)
features.detail: All REST routes: /api/scan, /api/stats, /api/files/{tree,list,search}, /api/categorize*, /api/hash*, /api/dedup*, /api/organize*, /api/structure*, /api/tasks*, /api/history*, /api/exceptions*, /api/settings*. Jinja2Templates + StaticFiles serve the dashboard. Background jobs run on threads guarded by _job_lock / _active_jobs.

features.name: filehq package init
features.detail: Marks C:\APPS\NAYA\filehq as the importable 'filehq' package so modules import as filehq.scanner, filehq.dedup, etc.

features.name: Connection + schema
features.detail: SQLite at db/filehq.db. PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, foreign_keys=ON, busy_timeout=5000. executescript creates 8 app tables (files, duplicate_groups, duplicate_members, operations, tasks, task_runs, exceptions, scans) + schema_info. SCHEMA_VERSION=1.

features.name: Idempotent migrations
features.detail: PRAGMA table_info checks then ALTER TABLE: adds duplicate_groups.review_action and operations.batch_id (+ idx_operations_batch_id) if missing. Safe to run on every init.

features.name: Dashboard stats aggregator
features.detail: One call returns total_files, total_size, duplicate_groups/files/size, operations, scans, active_exceptions, per-category and per-extension breakdowns, recent operations + scans. Drives /api/stats and the dashboard.

features.name: Directory walker / indexer
features.detail: os.walk with in-place dirnames[:] pruning of SKIP_DIRS + dot-folders. Per-file os.stat -> size/mtime/ctime/ext. INSERT new files, UPDATE changed files (and null their hashes). Opens a scans row, commits per directory, finalizes counts. ~2.86M rows indexed.

features.name: File-explorer tree
features.detail: Recursive directory tree (max_depth default 3) with per-node file_count and permission-denied handling, for the Explorer tab.

features.name: Extension -> category
features.detail: Maps extension to one of 8 categories from config (else 'Other'). Batched UPDATE (500-row executemany, 10k/50k batch) of category/archive_era/archive_year for rows where category IS NULL. Callable repeatedly until remaining=0.

features.name: Archive-era classifier
features.detail: Parses modified_date; returns (FORWARD, year) for year>=forward_year(2020) else (BACKWARD, year). Falls back to current year on parse error.

features.name: Two-phase fingerprint
features.detail: xxhash.xxh64. Partial = first 64KB + last 64KB (when size > 128KB). Full = streamed 1MB chunks. Both return (hex, None) or (None, 'missing'|'inaccessible') so unreadable files are flagged not retried.

features.name: Staged hashing pipeline
features.detail: Phase 1 SELECT size_bytes GROUP BY HAVING cnt>1 (only size-collision candidates). Phase 2 partial-hash candidates. Phase 3 full-hash only partial-hash collisions. Commits every 200 files; marks errors. Singletons never hashed.

features.name: Hash progress
features.detail: Returns total_hashable, partial_hashed, full_hashed and percentages for the UI progress bars.

features.name: Build duplicate groups
features.detail: Wipes + rebuilds duplicate_groups/members from files sharing hash_full (GROUP BY HAVING file_count>1). Marks earliest-modified member is_oldest=1 (the keeper). Computes wasted = single_size x (file_count-1). 694 groups / 1,618 members.

features.name: Group review + actions
features.detail: status pending|reviewed|resolved; review_action in {delete,move,rename,None}. bulk_mark_groups does a single IN(...) UPDATE transaction. get_duplicate_groups() paginates with JOIN to file detail.

features.name: Execute dedup actions
features.detail: Dry-run by default. For is_oldest=0 copies: delete (os.remove + status='missing'), move (shutil.move with collision suffix), or rename (_DUPE). Every real op logged to operations(reversible=1); group marked resolved. The original is always kept untouched.

features.name: ARCHIVE structure manager
features.detail: Python port of ARCHIVE-ControlPanel.ps1. Canonical tree: ARCHIVE\2020 - FORWARD|BACKWARD with 00_INBOUND/OUTBOUND/TEMP, 01_CURRENT/{01_MEDIA,02_SOFTWARE,03_DOCUMENTS}, 99_INDEX + DO_NOT_TOUCH folders.

features.name: Move planner (dry-run)
features.detail: Resolves each file's destination under ARCHIVE by category->subfolder map and era (FORWARD vs BACKWARD\{year}). Reads DB only; produces a plan, moves nothing.

features.name: Plan executor + undo
features.detail: Carries out a plan with a batch_id, logging each move to operations with an undo_path; undo_batch() reverses a batch. Destructive — gated by owner approval through the Naya bridge.

features.name: YAML config + naya.db override
features.detail: DEFAULT_CONFIG (app/archive/scanner/categories/scheduler) merged over config/config.yaml. primary_drive is overridden from naya.db key personal.default_scan_drive via naya_db.get_config() so the scan drive is never hardcoded.

features.name: DB maintenance engine
features.detail: VACUUM + ANALYZE; purges missing/inaccessible files, resolved duplicate groups+members, old task_runs, stale scans. health_report() returns size + recommendations. Safe-only: never touches pending groups or existing files.

features.name: Scheduled tasks
features.detail: Task CRUD endpoints + cron scheduling wired; config defaults scan_interval_hours=24, dedup_interval_hours=168. tasks/task_runs tables currently empty (0 rows) — no jobs registered yet.

features.name: REST + direct-DB bridge
features.detail: Wraps all 50+ FileHQ endpoints (_get/_post/_put/_delete to http://127.0.0.1:8200) AND opens a read-only SQLite connection (file:...?mode=ro) for fast lookups (db_file_count, db_largest_files, db_category_breakdown, db_drive_usage, db_search_files). _sanitize_http_error strips internal URLs/IPs from user-facing errors.

features.name: Intent + action detection
features.detail: Keyword match decides if a message is file-related; detect_action() maps it to scan/dedup_summary/largest_files/categorize/hash/search_files/etc. Destructive execute_dedup/execute_organize require approved=True (explicit 'you may proceed').

features.name: Prompt context + Telegram
features.detail: Builds a live [FILEHQ CONTEXT] block (stats, dedup summary, top categories, drive usage, active jobs, last scan) injected into Naya's system prompt; offline path tells the user how to start FileHQ. /files Telegram subcommands.
